posts.name: Kingofsouls
posts.cooked:
There are very few things in gaming that is worse than the dreaded Demonic Spider. These things in a nutshell are powerful enemies that are boss worthy but are in reality found amoung the common mook. And they tend to ruin the day of gamers should they get the chance.


So, in your experience, what are the most annoyingly lethal Mooks (i.e. not a character card) you've ever come across in Sentinels?
